title: Leader, Sales - Commercial Sector – KSA
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a leader to drive sales growth and strategic commercial priorities across KSA commercial markets, focusing on the private healthcare sector. Oversee direct account and architecture teams, optimise sales tactics, and manage executive-level relationships. Ideal for candidates with strong technology sales leadership experience and a proven track record in managing complex commercial accounts.
description:
Internal Opportunity Notice: This position is available to internal candidates up to grade 12. The final grade offer will be determined based on an objective assessment of individual performance and interview outcomes.

Meet the Team

The KSA Commercial team is dedicated to driving sustainable growth and portfolio profitability by delivering Cisco’s cutting-edge networking and technology solutions to a diverse range of commercial customers.

Our work is fundamental to the larger regional strategy, connecting businesses, government entities, and service providers to the global digital economy.

We are a high-energy, collaborative group consisting of account managers, technical architects, and partner leaders who thrive on solving complex business challenges together.

The team maintains a culture of agility and innovation, valuing diverse perspectives to better navigate the unique market conditions and regulatory landscapes across KSA .

It is an exciting time to join us as we lead digital transformation efforts in key market like Saudi Arabia, directly shaping the future of connectivity in the country.

Your Impact

Serve as a Regional Sales Manager leading direct account and architecture teams to drive sustained, multi-year sales growth across KSA commercial markets, and specifically in the private healthcare sector.

Direct resource utilization and strategic commercial priorities to align field, partner, and virtual team efforts with global corporate leadership guidance.

Review forecasts and sales data to optimize commercial sales tactics and provide data-driven insights that influence regional sales planning.

Coordinate joint planning sessions between partners and field teams to streamline execution and enhance market penetration across complex customer segments.

Manage executive-level relationships with CTOs, CIOs, and CFOs to understand their business roadmaps and align Cisco solutions to drive sustainable cross-portfolio growth.

Minimum Qualifications

Prior formal supervisory or people management experience within a professional setting.

Established background in technology sales and leadership.

Documented experience managing and closing complex commercial accounts with consistent quota attainment.

Demonstrated experience managing significant annual budgets for technology products or service offerings.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep understanding of KSA commercial market dynamics, regulatory environments, and local customer buying behaviors.

Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills to build and sustain high-performing teams.

Proven ability to facilitate complex, cross-functional initiatives involving services, software, and partner ecosystems.

Excellent commercial relationship management skills, including the ability to consultatively challenge customers to innovate their business models.

Market intelligence expertise with a focus on translating business climate insights into actionable competitive strategies.

• Nature of the Work: Hybrid Full Time
• Hours of work: 48 hours per week
• Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
• Application start and end date: Starting 26 of Aug, 2026 for approx. 4-6 weeks

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
